data.action: 手持红彤彤的苹果糖递向镜头，回眸浅笑
data.camera: medium shot, dynamic angle, vibrant festival background
data.description: 【艾莉 · 夏日祭典·和风浴衣与苹果糖】绚丽的夏日祭典灯笼长廊下，第一次换上和风淡蓝浴衣的艾莉将手里的红色苹果糖递到你面前，银发盘在脑后露出修长雪白的颈线——「这个叫苹果糖的东西比想象中甜得多呢。……要尝一口吗？只有一口哦。」
data.lighting: warm red and amber lantern illumination, night festival glow
data.promptProse: Alya offers her red candied apple beneath the summer festival's lantern corridor, silver hair gathered into a loose bun above her light-blue floral yukata. The dynamic medium view brings the candy forward and keeps the sash visible, with stalls extending behind her along the walkway. Red-and-amber lantern light warms her cheeks and glints on the sugar coating, shading the yukata folds beneath her raised hand.
data.title: 艾莉莎·米哈伊洛夫娜·九条 · 夏日祭典·和风浴衣与苹果糖
